source_metadata.title: Treatment options for progression or recurrence of glioblastoma: a network meta-analysis
source_metadata.source_type: Cochrane systematic review with network meta-analysis
source_metadata.publication: Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 2021, Issue 1

extraction_strategy.scope: Review-level methods, formal NMA results, principal safety findings, major evidence gaps, and author conclusions. Study-by-study characteristics and every narrative secondary report were not atomized as if they were primary-study results.

source_inconsistencies.issue: NMA participant totals differ between Summary of Findings tables and Discussion.
source_inconsistencies.details: Summary of Findings 1 reports 9 RCTs/1734 participants for OS, whereas Discussion reports 9 RCTs/1931 participants. Summary of Findings 2 reports 7 RCTs/1383 participants for PFS, whereas Discussion reports 7 RCTs/1500 participants. Atoms use the explicit Summary of Findings totals and preserve the conflict here rather than resolving it.

source_inconsistencies.issue: BEV+dasatinib SAE estimate appears misprinted in Summary of Findings 4 text extraction.
source_inconsistencies.details: Summary-of-findings text shows RR 0.52 with CI 0.69-3.34, which is internally impossible. Figure 11 and Table 5 show RR 1.52 (0.69-3.34). The atom uses 1.52 and anchors to Figure 11.

extraction_limitations: LiteratureAtom was designed for primary literature; this source is a systematic review/NMA. Formal network estimates are treated as results generated by the review, while underlying individual-study results are generally not re-labeled as primary results.

The review contains 42 included studies, 57 excluded studies, 20 ongoing studies, extensive study-characteristics tables, and narrative study-level findings. These were mapped for SEA and the reference queue but not exhaustively atomized one study at a time.
GRADE certainty is preserved in tags because the current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated certainty-of-evidence field.
Treatment ranking is preserved only as qualitative context/limitations because rank alone does not encode certainty and can be misleading.
schema_gaps: No dedicated source_type or evidence-synthesis atom kind for systematic reviews/network meta-analyses.
No native field for network topology, direct-versus-indirect evidence, inconsistency statistics, or treatment ranking.
No dedicated field for secondary-reported primary-study results distinct from review-generated pooled/network results; tags are used to clarify source type.
